description: A publicly-launched, guest-and-registered web chat application (chatib.us-style), built as the vehicle for an evaluation of the Rosetta instruction layer for AI coding agents.

servicesDescription.chat: Single Node.js service: HTTP API, static client, WebSocket chat rooms with in-process presence state, and session auth. Self-hosted Postgres on the same host.

sdlc.infrastructure: Single DigitalOcean droplet ($6/mo, 1 GB RAM, 2 GB swap) running Node.js, PostgreSQL and Caddy under systemd
sdlc.monitoring: [MONITORING - not yet chosen; required before public launch]
sdlc.logging: [LOGGING - tool not yet chosen; retention decided: IP + timestamp logs kept 30 days (USER-DECIDED, Phase 8)]
sdlc.security: [SECURITY_TOOL - secrets currently planned as systemd EnvironmentFile; no manager chosen]
sdlc.code_graph: Built-in docs/CODEMAP.md plus typescript-lsp for local symbol navigation. No third-party code-graph tool; no source access granted to any external service.

vocabulary.guest: Unauthenticated user who joins with only a nickname, no password and no persistent account. Session is ephemeral.
vocabulary.registered user: User with a durable account and credentials. May be created fresh or upgraded from an active guest session.
vocabulary.guest upgrade: Converting an in-flight guest session into a registered account while preserving nickname and room membership.
vocabulary.room: A named multi-user chat channel. Membership and socket fan-out are held in process memory, not in the database.
vocabulary.presence: The live roster of users currently connected to a room, derived from open WebSocket connections.
vocabulary.DM: Direct 1:1 private message between two users, outside any room. Deliberately held back as the un-pre-designed baseline feature for the Rosetta-vs-plain-Claude comparison.
vocabulary.moderation: Report, remove and ban capability plus the audit log behind it. Gates public launch.
vocabulary.gated launch: Deployed and reachable but closed to strangers behind Caddy basic auth (reverse-proxy layer, no application code), used for every phase before moderation ships.
vocabulary.public launch: Open guest access for anonymous strangers on the internet. Permitted only once rate limiting and the minimum moderation set are live.
vocabulary.walking skeleton: Thinnest end-to-end slice - nickname, join, send, receive - deployed to the real droplet to prove the whole path works.
vocabulary.baseline feature: A feature built deliberately without Rosetta, to measure Rosetta's effect. Without it this POC is a demo, not an evaluation.
vocabulary.Rosetta: The subject under evaluation: a versioned markdown instruction layer (bootstrap, workflow classifier, skills, subagents, HITL gates) loaded into the coding agent at session start.
